script_text: The Moon is about to ignite your 7th House, Cancer, and love is about to flip. Mars squares your ruling Moon Monday, creating tension in relationships and making you reactive. Wednesday is your worst day because Mercury opposes Neptune in your 7th House, clouding communication. Hold back before reacting — the fog lifts by Thursday. Venus enters Virgo and lands in your 8th House Wednesday night, transforming shared finances and intimacy. Jupiter trines your Sun in Leo this weekend, opening a doorway for career recognition and money growth. The water element stabilizes, letting you make clear, confident moves. Thursday is your power day because Venus enters your 8th House, unlocking hidden opportunities in love and money. Tuesday is your worst day because Mars squares your Moon, triggering unnecessary conflict at home. Let the Moon guide your career decisions — trust intuition over logic when opportunities arise. Follow for daily updates.
